name: parroquia-app
description: Parroquia native launcher (Capacitor). Commands are driven from the repo-root scripts (app:build / app:add / app:sync / app:open / app:run). The dependency list mirrors the repo-root package.json on purpose: the Hub installs the hoisted node_modules, while declaring them here lets the Capacitor CLI discover the plugin modules (it scopes discovery to the app's own package.json).
